description: MCP server for JobGPT — search jobs, auto-apply, generate resumes, and track applications from Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, and any MCP client

tool_signatures.name: add_job_to_applications
tool_signatures.description: Add a job from search results to your applications. Use this when a user wants to save/track a job they found.

jobId.description: The job ID to add to applications

jobHuntId.description: The job hunt ID to add this job to

parameters.name: jobHuntId
parameters.description: The job hunt ID to add this job to

parameters.name: jobId
parameters.description: The job ID to add to applications

tool_signatures.name: apply_to_job
tool_signatures.description: Trigger auto-apply for a job application. This will automatically fill and submit the job application form. You can optionally specify a specific resume to use for this application.

id.description: The application ID to auto-apply for

resumeUri.description: Optional: The URI of a specific resume to use for this application. Get this from list_resumes or upload_resume. If not provided, the primary resume will be used.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The application ID to auto-apply for

parameters.name: resumeUri
parameters.description: Optional: The URI of a specific resume to use for this application. Get this from list_resumes or upload_resume. If not provided, the primary resume will be used.

tool_signatures.name: create_job_hunt
tool_signatures.description: Create a new job hunt to start tracking and applying to jobs. A job hunt defines what jobs you want to find based on titles, locations, skills, salary, etc. You need at least one job hunt to use match_jobs or add_job_to_applications.

remote.description: When true, only return remote jobs. When false or omitted, return all jobs (both remote and non-remote).

industries.description: Industries (use get_industries to see valid values)

relevancy.description: Search relevancy mode - HIGH for strict title/skills matching (recommended), MEDIUM for broader keyword-based results. Default is null (MEDIUM behavior).

excludedKeywords.description: Keywords to exclude from job results

excludedTitles.description: Job titles to exclude from results

autoMode.description: Enable full autopilot mode (default: false). When enabled, jobs are automatically matched, scored against your resume using AI, and applied to if they meet your minMatchScore threshold. Resume customization (if enabled) is applied before each application. Each auto-apply consumes a credit.

dailyLimit.description: Maximum jobs to auto-apply per day (default: 5, max: 100)

minMatchScore.description: Minimum match score for auto-apply (0-1). Jobs below this score will not be auto-applied. Default is 0.70 (70%) when not explicitly set.

customizeResume.description: Enable AI resume customization for applications (default: false)
